column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
It's all your fault that Manami got the wrong idea!
Huh?! Why are we talking about plain girl now?!
Hey now...
So that Kirino can understand, I explained it to her using excessively polite terms.
...So that's what happened. Do you understand?
That happens a lot, doesn't it?
That doesn't happen!  What kind of idiot turns down their childhood friend with the reason being he needed to fully complete a perverted game?!
Tch. Guess I gotta do something. Wait a second.
Just as she said that, she turned around and disappeared into the crowd.
Don't tell me, she's really going to clear up the misunderstanding with Manami for me?
Oh that's great, I'm so relieved...
No sooner than I had thought it, Manami came.
But somehow her expression was different than usual...
Kyou-chan...
Manami.
Um, I heard what Kirino-chan had to say.
Ah... Yeah!
As an apology for that phone call earlier, you'll come help us make confectionery, right?
Y-Yeah...
This is somehow different from what we said...
Kirino must have figured something out...
But!  That's...
Huh? What is it?
Just helping is already good... enough...
...What are you saying?
I heard from Kirino-chan...
W-What?!
That you were only going to... help while wearing only an apron...
Uu...
Wait!  Manami!  I'm not that perverted!
And that... I also have to do it too.  Naked apron... guu.. uu... wahhh... !
Wait!  Manami-san?!
My words no longer reached her as she burst into tears.
No matter what I said, she continued crying as if she couldn't hear.
As I wondered how this could have come to be, I realized only one thing could have happened.
That is... this situation could only have been made by Kirino!
